name: Startup Tracker

sources.title: Homepage — 'Discover and track startups from MVP to IPO'; 'Get Started — it's Free'; nav links 'Add startup' to /crowdsourcing/
Add-startup (crowdsourcing) route — renders an empty JS app shell to plain fetches; also accessible as in-app 'Add startup' nav item

conditions: Free product ('Get Started — it's Free') but adding a startup requires signing in to the web app; the crowdsourcing form is JS-rendered and not publicly documented
requirements: Company must be a startup — the dataset spans MVP-to-IPO companies, aggregated from Crunchbase, Product Hunt, Beta List and crowdsourced additions
Sign-up/login required before the Add startup form works
Site also accepts correction requests: 'Missing profile or profile missing some info? Let us know' via hello@startuptracker.io
preparation: Startup name, website URL, and canonical social profiles (data merges with Crunchbase/PH records)
Founding/funding facts if known — profiles are 'one pagers' with summary info and links
An email address for the free account
workflow: Create a free account at startuptracker.io/home
Inside the app use 'Add startup' (routes to /crowdsourcing/) and submit the startup's details
Alternatively email hello@startuptracker.io to request a missing profile be added or corrected
Confirm the profile resolves at startuptracker.io/startups/<slug>
watchFor: /crowdsourcing returns 'Not Found' without the trailing slash and an empty shell to non-JS fetches — must be done in a real browser session
Profiles are crowdsourced + aggregated; a listing here is a tracking profile, not a promotional launch post
Site footer is dated 2020 — confirm the app still ingests new startups before investing effort
hello@startuptracker.io is a fallback route if the in-app form fails
countsAsLive: A public profile page exists at startuptracker.io/startups/<slug> viewable without login
unknowns: Exact fields on the add-startup form (JS-gated)
